entry.title: Creeper Case
entry.summary:
Vendor: Sparrows
Type:
Price: 15.95

While individual preferences vary, the "Creeper Case" is built specifically for discreet and night operations. It has multiple features deemed indispensable for operational and reconnaissance teams.

The Creeper Case features two opening mechanisms: classic velcro and silent tab, when discretion is required.

Inside is a phosphorescent card that allows for rapid tool identification in low/no light conditions, without compromising your night vision. The card can also be reversed for no-light conditions.

Contains a removable logo patch that can be installed on the velcro to ensure nothing snags during "silent mode". If the logo is removed, pack has no branding or identifying features.

Built to hold your most important tools: can comfortably hold 4 picks with handles, or 6 without handles, and has a dedicated pouch for tension wrenches (up to 6 comfortably)

What's Included

  • 1x Creeper Case
  • 1x Reversible phosphorescent card
  • 1x Logo Patch (for silent operation)

Technical Information

  • Dimensions: 13.5 x 8.5 x 1.5 cm
  • Card: 12 x 6.5 cm
  • Patch: 25 x 25 mm
